items.title: Anal fissure surgery
items.text: Surgical treatments for chronic constipation disorders, excision of rectal pockets, surgical procedures for anal hemorrhoids, anal fistulas, anal abscesses, and Hirschsprung's disease.

items.title: Hemorrhoid surgery
items.text: It refers to an abnormal dilation of the blood vessels located at the end of the rectum and anus.

items.title: Ingrown toenail surgeries
items.text: An ingrown nail occurs when the nail bends at its outer edge and grows into the skin.

items.title: Laparoscopic surgeries
items.text: Laparoscopic gallbladder removal surgeries, surgical appendectomy, repair of abdominal wall muscles, and laparoscopic hernia repair.

items.title: Minimally invasive surgeries
items.text: Laparoscopic gallbladder removal surgeries, surgical and laparoscopic appendectomy, abdominal wall muscle repair, and laparoscopic hernia repair.

items.title: Colon surgeries
items.text: Surgical removal of the colon, either completely or partially, using laparoscopic techniques, and excision of benign and malignant colon tumors.
